Position Summary

To become a member of the Intensive Care trainee team delivering advanced Intensive Care support. Suitable for Intensive Care Basic Trainees seeking to gain further experience and training in Intensive Care including subspecialties of Trauma, Cardiothoracic, Neuro ICU, ECMO and Paediatric ICU. Demonstrated commitment to CICM training is an essential requirement.

Where you'll be working

The John Hunter Hospital ICU is a Level 6 referral centre for critically ill patients in the Hunter New England, Mid North Coast and Northern NSW Local Health Districts. It is the default centre for Trauma, Neurosurgery, Stroke, Vascular, Cardiothoracic and major General Surgery, as well as Interventional Radiology and Neuroradiology. The ICU is accredited for all aspects of CICM training including paediatrics through a 6-month rotation in JHH PICU which is one of only three tertiary PICUs in NSW. 
The 796-bed hospital is the principal teaching hospital of the University of Newcastle, with JHH ICU aiming to be a training destination through strong educational support for both the CICM First and Second Part examinations.

JHH is the only trauma centre in NSW outside the Sydney metropolitan area and is the state's busiest trauma hospital and the second busiest in Australia.

Living in our region

Newcastle and its surround offers an excellent lifestyle choice combining a relaxed coastal environment with strong opportunities for individuals, couples and families. Our hospitals operate within a well-connected and supportive network, with training sites continuing to expand beyond traditional clinical service delivery. We foster a strong culture of learning, education, professionalism, mentorship and role modelling.

What you'll be doing

.The position would be suitable for junior medical officers seeking to gain further experience and training in Intensive Care Medicine whilst undertaking learning and professional development activities with the aim of progressing to an advanced trainee of the College of Intensive Care Medicine (CICM)

.Beginning to take a leadership role in coordinating the admission, management and discharge planning of intensive care patients whilst ensuring a high level of documentation and communication with home teams

.The day-to-day assessment and management of intensive care patients within the unit, communicating with them and their family regarding the nature of their condition and its treatment.

 
 

 
 
 
 
 
 

 

Qualifications

MBBS or equivalent, currently registered or eligible for registration with the Medical Board of Australia.

Either minimum of 3 years postgraduate training, preferably with recent senior resident experience in ICU, Anaesthetics, or Emergency Medicine, OR be applying to CICM training in the first year of employment

Demonstrates ability to work independently within a supervised complex clinical environment utilising excellent clinical skills, judgment and expertise.

Ability to demonstrate sound decision making and awareness of when and who to seek further advice.

Demonstrated experience using excellent communication skills (verbal and written) with patients, relatives, medical and nursing colleagues, Allied health, ward staff and administration staff to ensure the appropriate management of the patient

Ability to build strong collegial relationships across all healthcare disciplines and foster a positive workplace culture.

Demonstrates teamwork, time management and problem solving skills as part of a multidisciplinary team.

A professional attitude and flexibility in work role with a preparedness and ability to participate in after-hours rosters to deliver patient care.

KAEFER Integrated Services Pty Ltd Is the Australian subsidiary of the KAEFER Group, a company renowned worldwide for excellence in the fields of industrial insulation And associated industries, with operations in more than 40 countries And over +30,000 employees worldwide. We specialise in the supply of Industrial Services to the Oil, LNG, Mining And Power Industries And pride ourselves on our effective delivery of quality products And our exceptional service to clientele. We are also committed to the continuous development And training of our personnel to maintain a safe And rewarding work environment.

KAEFER Integrated Services Pty Ltd are currently seeking experienced Advanced Scaffolders for ongoing throughout various project locations in Australia including Western Australia, Northern Territory, South Australia and Queensland Region.

Pay: $76,515.00 – $86,000.00 per year

Job description:

Erect and dismantle scaffolding to provide work platforms on building, industrial and other sites, for temporary structures such as access ways, stages and catwalks, and for the purpose of painting, repairing, seating, disguising building facades, etc
Check the construction requirements from visually inspecting the access requirement location, select materials and set ground levels, fit together steel pipes, support braces and clamps to form bases for scaffolds, lift and position sections of scaffolding and bolt pipes together to build up scaffolding; place planks over horizontal bars to create platforms, check levels in scaffolding structures, use prefabricated scaffolding when available, and dismantle scaffolding at the completion of a Job.
Ensure correct tagging of scaffolding is in place.
All scaffold components used and structures built are to comply with current Australian & New Zealand Standard AS/NZC 1576 and all other relevant standard as applicable.

The successful candidate will be required to have the following:

Minimum of 3 years' experience as an Advanced Scaffolder
OHS Construction Induction White Card
Current High Risk Licence
Current Working at Heights ticket is essential
Current Confined Space Access ticket
Current Drivers Licence
Have a strong understanding of safety and PPE requirements in an industrial environment
Have an ability to work effectively in a team environment to ensure strict deadlines are met in a timely manner

KAEFER Integrated Services is an equal opportunity employer and strongly encourages Females and Indigenous Australians to apply.
